why:
RE-VERDICTED gap -> divergence 2026-09-25 (phase-467 Q3). SHIPPED: `nros_core::Time::to_ros_msg<M: SecNanosecMsg>(&self) -> M`. The name now corresponds; two things about the SHAPE do not, and both have a reason that is not a preference.

**No `Result`, deliberately.** `rclrs::Time::to_ros_msg(&self) -> Result<builtin_interfaces::msg::Time, TryFromIntError>` needs one because its `Time` holds `i64` nanoseconds and narrowing to `sec: i32` can overflow. Ours IS `{ sec: i32, nanosec: u32 }` (`packages/core/nros-core/src/time.rs`), so the conversion is two field copies and cannot fail. Shipping an infallible operation behind a `Result` so a ported `t.to_ros_msg()?` keeps compiling would hide a difference instead of making the compiler point at it -- the inverse of RFC-0089's rule. That is what `adopt-bounded` records here: the call ports unchanged, the `?` does not, and it fails LOUD and local ("the `?` operator can only be applied to values that implement `Try`"), one character to fix.

**Generic return, not a named message type.** `nros-core` can never name a message type: every generated message crate depends on it, so the dependency the other way is a cycle, and message types are generated per USER package (RFC-0023 / RFC-0067) -- there is no one `builtin_interfaces` crate for the client library to name. C++ solved this with `template <typename TimeMsgT> void to_msg(TimeMsgT&)` (`cpp:Time::to_msg`), which binds structurally. Rust has no structural bound, so the substitute is an AUTHORED trait `rosidl-codegen` implements for every generated message with the `{ sec, nanosec }` field set -- keyed on the SHAPE, so the binding set is the same one the C++ template has. See `rust:SecNanosecMsg`. The call site reads the same as rclrs's (`msg.header.stamp = node.now().to_ros_msg();`); only a turbofish-free inference replaces the named return type.

It cost an `NROS_CODEGEN_VERSION` bump, 7 -> 8: the policy names "a trait signature generated code implements" as the trigger, and this is the first move that pulls it. Additive -- `NROS_CODEGEN_VERSION_MIN` stays 2.
